<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-schema-config.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **246** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **181** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **181**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **122** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **24** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7993aa76afc4e4cab80aaf5c813bce00e7e11bc4` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d0416d22493495f7b2eb0f3f5b4899f820b0b29c` — the merge of head `55e15aeed675f6d76c19f75c8dde997836c7a415` into base `7993aa76afc4e4cab80aaf5c813bce00e7e11bc4`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d0416d22493495f7b2eb0f3f5b4899f820b0b29c && git checkout d0416d22493495f7b2eb0f3f5b4899f820b0b29c
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7993aa76afc4e4cab80aaf5c813bce00e7e11bc4 55e15aeed675f6d76c19f75c8dde997836c7a415 && git checkout -B drift-repro 7993aa76afc4e4cab80aaf5c813bce00e7e11bc4 && git merge --no-ff 55e15aeed675f6d76c19f75c8dde997836c7a415

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7993aa76afc4e4cab80aaf5c813bce00e7e11bc4
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7993aa76afc4e4cab80aaf5c813bce00e7e11bc4` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `55e15aeed675f6d76c19f75c8dde997836c7a415`
Local-runs: none

Face: declaration only (`Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the claim, PR body and changeset). No `packages/spec/src/**` and no governed path (`check-governed-merges --pr 32296`: not governed).

### ① Derived judgments

- `/sso/register` admits an Entra ID registration (issuer `https://login.microsoftonline.com/...`) whose discovery names its userinfo endpoint on `https://graph.microsoft.com`; refused before. The table is closed and keyed on the exact https issuer host, and the added origin lives only in the scoped before-hook context of that path, after the router's Origin check; the CSRF allow-list is unchanged and pinned as a CONTROL. Any other issuer whose discovery names a foreign host is still refused (CONTROL). Widening, correct.
- Group projection reads the provider's groups claim from the ID token when userinfo lacks it; userinfo wins where both carry it. The token read is the one `@better-auth/sso` verified in the same callback (`provisionUser`); the read decodes, it does not re-verify. Overage grants nothing and warns once per provider. Widening (a member is granted where before nothing was).
- `sys_sso_provider.skip_user_info` (boolean, default false, `trackHistory`) and the bridge's `userInfoEndpoint`/`skipUserInfo` params: new optional inputs. Widening.
- `error_description=missing_user_info` becomes `email_claim_missing` for the no-email sign-in (`error=invalid_provider` unchanged), exported as `SSO_OIDC_EMAIL_CLAIM_MISSING`. A changed refusal value, declared in the changeset with the client remedy; no previously accepted sign-in is refused.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@objectstack/plugin-auth` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` with `Metadata-protocol: none` matches ruling A (no metadata authoring surface changes). No major.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag: the refusal wording change is declared, with the exported constant. Accepted.
- Dev flag: the Setup form lacks the new params; filed as `domain:ui` child #32297.
- A security item is with the owner seat; nothing in this PR widens what an issuer or discovery document can make the server trust.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay write).

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Microsoft Entra ID 现在能通过 OIDC 注册和登录:内建表只在注册 `login.microsoftonline.com` 的提供方时,为发现文档校验信任 `https://graph.microsoft.com`(CSRF 白名单不变);userinfo 不带组时从已验证的 ID token 读组;新增「只从 ID token 读声明」开关(`skip_user_info`),配合把邮箱映射到 `preferred_username`,无邮箱用户也能登录。
- **为什么改**:今天每个 Entra ID 客户第一天就被拒绝注册,唯一的绕法是放宽全局可信来源(连带 CSRF 白名单);组映射对 Entra 永远不生效;无邮箱用户登录失败。
- **风险与回滚**:低。只放宽、不收窄;无邮箱登录失败的 `error_description` 从 `missing_user_info` 改为 `email_claim_missing`(已在 changeset 说明,匹配旧值的客户端需改)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-discovery-companion-origins.ts`,`sso-group-projection.ts` 的 `resolveSsoGroupClaim`,`sso-sign-in-options.ts` 的 `skipUserInfo`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/sso-discovery-companion-origins.test.ts src/sso-oidc-refusal-cause.test.ts src/sso-sign-in-options.test.ts`,全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,Tier S,席位落地。

**席位意见**:ACCEPT。信任范围限定在一张封闭表、一个路径、发现校验这一步;组声明只读本次回调里已验证的 token;Setup 表单的配套字段另立 #32297。

## 席位核对

Head-sha: `55e15aeed675f6d76c19f75c8dde997836c7a415`

1. **形态**:30 个文件,+1167/−39 = 1206 行;NOT governed,Tier S。`Clause-②: yes (widening)`、`Metadata-protocol: none`,两包 patch。
2. **契约复核**:TIER_DEFAULT 申报面 PASS,6774529957。
3. **前提实测与门禁**:dev 在 base d391babc 上用 Entra 形状的本地替身复现三处缺陷(9 个 pin 先红);消融五腿各自变红(含「Graph 进全局可信来源」时 CSRF CONTROL 变红)。head check-runs 53 条,38 success、15 skipped、0 失败;`mergeable_state` clean;K = 7(PRBASE 7993aa76),其后 main 未新增语种包。
4. **接受的偏差**:拒绝文案值改名(上文风险行);`dispatch-gates` 本地 1 项 exit 3(teardown-shape 自测需完整克隆),CI 已覆盖。
